results.rationale: CO-PROFILE explicitly lists ISO 9001 under certifications_held, meeting the mandatory ISO 9001 requirement.
CO-PROFILE explicitly lists ISO 27001 under certifications_held, meeting the mandatory ISO 27001 requirement.
The provided capability records are for cybersecurity projects and do not evidence at least three web/software development projects valued ≥ PKR 5M within the last five years.
CO-PROFILE confirms FBR National Tax Number with Active Taxpayer (ATL) status, satisfying the eligibility requirement.
Procedural commitment—bid security will be furnished in the submission, and CO-PROFILE indicates ability to arrange CDR/bank guarantee from scheduled banks within facility limits.
Prior LMS development deployments credibly support delivering a modern maintainable web stack with CMS functionality for non-technical staff.
Cybersecurity and ERP implementation experience credibly supports implementing secure authentication, RBAC, and user action audit trails.
ERP implementation records support REST API integration experience, but the evidence does not explicitly confirm delivery of a tested payment gateway integration.
